---
title: "UAM Capacity · Risco vs Capacidade"
subtitle: "Corredor Interlagos — sweep K × C × routing × policy"
format:
  html:
    theme: darkly
    page-layout: full
    self-contained: true
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        /* ── Estado global por tab ─────────────────────────────────────── */
        window.riskMeta  = {};   /* uid → [{sc, k, pol}, …]  */
        window.riskState = {};   /* uid → {sc, k}            */

        /* Chamado pelos botões de filtro */
        function riskFilter(uid, dim, val) {
          var s = window.riskState[uid];
          if (dim === 'sc') s.sc = val;
          else              s.k  = parseInt(val);

          var meta = window.riskMeta[uid];
          var vis  = meta.map(function(m) {
            return m.sc === s.sc && m.k === s.k;
          });

          var ctr  = document.getElementById('risk-ctr-' + uid);
          var pdiv = ctr.querySelector('.plotly-graph-div');
          if (pdiv && pdiv._fullLayout) {
            Plotly.restyle(pdiv, { visible: vis });
          }

          ctr.querySelectorAll('[data-sc]').forEach(function(b) {
            _btnActive(b, b.dataset.sc === s.sc, '#378ADD');
          });
          ctr.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(function(b) {
            _btnActive(b, parseInt(b.dataset.k) === s.k, '#F4A261');
          });
        }

        function _btnActive(b, on, accent) {
          b.style.background  = on ? accent   : '#1a1a2e';
          b.style.color       = on ? '#ffffff' : '#a6adc8';
          b.style.borderColor = on ? accent   : '#3a3a5a';
        }

        /* Resize plotly quando o tab fica visível (corrige render em display:none) */
        document.addEventListener('shown.bs.tab', function(e) {
          var target = e.target.getAttribute('data-bs-target')
                    || ('#' + e.target.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
          if (!target) return;
          var pane = document.querySelector(target);
          if (!pane) return;
          pane.querySelectorAll('.plotly-graph-div').forEach(function(d) {
            if (d._fullLayout) Plotly.Plots.resize(d);
          });
        });
        </script>
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

df <- read.csv("data/capacity_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

POL_COLORS <- c(
  "round-robin"      = "#378ADD",
  "round-robin-sw"   = "#7db8e8",
  "pf-classic"       = "#D85A30",
  "pf-classic-sw"    = "#e8956a",
  "aoi-pure"         = "#1D9E75",
  "aoi-normalized"   = "#2DC4A0",
  "risk-aware"       = "#7F77DD",
  "max-weight-drift" = "#F4A261",
  "max-weight-sw"    = "#f9c784"
)

BG    <- "#1e1e2e"; PANEL <- "#13131f"
TEXT  <- "#cdd6f4"; AXIS  <- "#a6adc8"; GRID  <- "#2a2a4a"
C_TICKS <- sort(unique(df$C))

EXP_LABELS <- c(
  "capacity_15min"        = "15 min · original",
  "capacity_15min_sw_nsw" = "15 min · sw vs nsw"
)
get_exp_label <- function(e) { l <- EXP_LABELS[[e]]; if (is.null(l)) e else l }

# ── Helpers para botões HTML ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
.btn_style <- function(active, accent) {
  bg  <- if (active) accent   else "#1a1a2e"
  col <- if (active) "#ffffff" else "#a6adc8"
  brd <- if (active) accent   else "#3a3a5a"
  paste0(
    "background:", bg, ";color:", col, ";border:1px solid ", brd, ";",
    "border-radius:5px;padding:4px 11px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;",
    "transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap;"
  )
}
.lbl <- function(txt) {
  tags$span(txt,
    style = paste0(
      "color:#6a6a8a;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;",
      "text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;align-self:center;"
    )
  )
}
.sep <- function() {
  tags$div(style="width:1px;background:#2a2a4a;align-self:stretch;margin:0 2px;")
}

# ── Constrói gráfico + barra de filtros para um experimento ──────────────────
build_risk_chart <- function(d, uid) {
  pols_exp <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(d$policy))

  # Agrega: (cenário, K, C, política) → risco médio
  df_sc <- d |>
    group_by(scenario, K, C, policy) |>
    summarise(mean_risk = mean(mean_risk, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Adiciona "Todos": média sobre cenários
  df_avg <- df_sc |>
    group_by(K, C, policy) |>
    summarise(mean_risk = mean(mean_risk, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(scenario = "Todos")

  df_plot   <- bind_rows(df_sc, df_avg)
  scenarios <- c("Todos", sort(unique(df_sc$scenario)))
  k_vals    <- sort(unique(d$K))

  default_sc <- "Todos"
  default_k  <- k_vals[1]

  # ── Traces plotly ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fig        <- plot_ly()
  trace_meta <- vector("list", 0)
  seen_pols  <- character(0)

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (k in k_vals) {
      for (pol in pols_exp) {
        sub <- filter(df_plot, scenario == sc, K == k, policy == pol)
        if (nrow(sub) == 0) next

        is_default <- sc == default_sc && k == default_k
        first_leg  <- !pol %in% seen_pols
        if (first_leg) seen_pols <- c(seen_pols, pol)

        trace_meta[[length(trace_meta) + 1]] <- list(
          sc  = sc,
          k   = as.integer(k),
          pol = pol
        )

        fig <- add_trace(fig,
          data          = sub,
          x             = ~C,
          y             = ~mean_risk,
          type          = "scatter",
          mode          = "lines+markers",
          name          = pol,
          legendgroup   = pol,
          showlegend    = first_leg,
          visible       = is_default,
          line          = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], width = 2.5),
          marker        = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], size  = 6),
          hovertemplate = paste0(
            "<b>", pol, "</b><br>C = %{x}<br>Risco = %{y:.4g}<extra></extra>"
          )
        )
      }
    }
  }

  fig <- layout(fig,
    xaxis  = list(
      title    = "Capacidade C (drones simultâneos)",
      color    = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID,
      tickvals = C_TICKS, zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    yaxis  = list(
      title  = "Risco médio total",
      color  = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    plot_bgcolor  = PANEL,
    paper_bgcolor = BG,
    font          = list(color = TEXT, size = 11),
    legend        = list(
      font  = list(color = TEXT, size = 10),
      bgcolor = BG,
      title   = list(text = "Política", font = list(color = AXIS, size = 10))
    ),
    margin    = list(l = 70, r = 20, t = 16, b = 55),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

  # ── Barra de filtros (HTML puro) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  sc_btns <- lapply(scenarios, function(sc) {
    lbl <- if (sc == "Todos") "Todos (média)" else sc
    tags$button(lbl,
      `data-sc` = sc,
      onclick   = sprintf("riskFilter('%s','sc','%s')", uid, sc),
      style     = .btn_style(sc == default_sc, "#378ADD")
    )
  })

  k_btns <- lapply(k_vals, function(k) {
    tags$button(paste0("K = ", k),
      `data-k` = k,
      onclick   = sprintf("riskFilter('%s','k',%d)", uid, as.integer(k)),
      style     = .btn_style(k == default_k, "#F4A261")
    )
  })

  filter_bar <- tags$div(
    style = paste0(
      "display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 14px;",
      "padding:9px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;",
      "background:#0d0d18;border-radius:7px;align-items:center;"
    ),
    .lbl("Cenário"),
    tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;", sc_btns),
    .sep(),
    .lbl("K slots/época"),
    tags$div(style = "display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;", k_btns)
  )

  # ── Script com metadados da trace (injeta estado global) ──────────────────
  meta_js <- tags$script(HTML(sprintf(
    "window.riskMeta['%s']  = %s;\nwindow.riskState['%s'] = {sc:'Todos', k:%d};",
    uid, toJSON(trace_meta, auto_unbox = TRUE),
    uid, as.integer(default_k)
  )))

  # ── Container identificado para riskFilter() ─────────────────────────────
  tags$div(
    id    = paste0("risk-ctr-", uid),
    style = "padding:10px 4px 0;",
    filter_bar,
    meta_js,
    fig
  )
}

# ── Tab por experimento ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build_exp_tab <- function(exp_name, exp_df) {
  uid <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", exp_name)
  nav_panel(
    get_exp_label(exp_name),
    build_risk_chart(exp_df, uid)
  )
}
```

> **`r nrow(df)` runs** · K ∈ {`r paste(sort(unique(df$K)), collapse=", ")`} · C `r min(df$C)`–`r max(df$C)` · `r length(unique(df$experiment))` experimentos · `r length(unique(df$policy))` políticas

```{r tabs}
experiments <- unique(df$experiment)
top_panels  <- lapply(experiments, function(e) {
  build_exp_tab(e, filter(df, experiment == e))
})
do.call(navset_tab, c(top_panels, list(id = "exp_tabs")))
```
